title: NBA 2K27 GTA 6 crossover brings Vice City Edition
description: The NBA 2K27 GTA 6 crossover starts November 27 with a Vice City Edition, themed Season 3 content and free play for GTA+ members on PS5 and Xbox.

body.text: The NBA 2K27 GTA 6 crossover is official. According to GameSpot, Take-Two Interactive and 2K Sports will bring Vice City to NBA 2K27 from November 27, alongside a special NBA 2K27 Vice City Edition made to promote GTA 6. A special edition of one game built to advertise another is unusual, and GameSpot notes it may be a first for the industry.
What the NBA 2K27 GTA 6 crossover includes

The crossover runs through Season 3 of NBA 2K27's live-service league. Vice City-themed content and rewards will appear in The City social hub and in MyTeam mode, as part of a three-week promotion with extra bonuses for GTA+ members.

Players can unlock themed apparel, including Vice City and Los Santos jerseys, plus Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell employee outfits. Limited-time events named Conquer Leonida and Vice Run will run through the season.

items: Wear & Earn events on Wednesdays, where wearing Rockstar Games collaboration gear earns extra reputation
Neon vs. Noir, a 5v5 full-court mode pitting a Vice City team against a Los Santos lineup
MyTeam Vice City-themed cards, a powerful new Premier Exchange card and limited-time modes

body.text: Vice City Edition price and Season 3 passes

The digital-only Vice City Edition costs $80. Miami Heat's Bam Adebayo is on the cover, and the artwork carries the signature Vice City neon glow. It also adds bonus Vice City content and benefits for GTA+ subscribers, and it comes bundled with the Season 3 Pro Pass.

If you skip that edition, the cosmetics cost extra. The Season 3 Pro Pass is $10 and unlocks the premium track with rewards such as Burger Shot gear, the Cluckin' Bell outfit, a Cactus Jack jersey and Macca the Gator. The $20 Hall of Fame Pass includes all of that plus 10 instant Level Skips, an extra 15% XP booster and 15,000 VC. GameSpot says you still need to grind through the 40-level season track to get all the GTA-themed cosmetics.
GTA+ perks and the Miami Heat tie-in

GTA+ members on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S can play the standard edition of NBA 2K27 for free from November 27 to January 15, 2027. If they decide to buy, they get 20% off. GTA 6 preorders also include a one-month GTA+ trial, per the report.
Members can also download a Vice City bonus pack with a blue boat hat, an oversized T-shirt, 30 skill boosts for five games and 15 Gatorade boosts for five games.
The promotion goes beyond the game. On November 18, the Miami Heat will wear GTA 6-inspired jerseys for one night when they host the Milwaukee Bucks, on a court inspired by Vice City.

GTA 6 marketing is clearly ramping up as launch gets closer, and this is unlikely to be the last tie-in. Keep an eye on the November 18 Heat game, then on how the Season 3 events play out from November 27. All prices in the report are in US dollars, and GameSpot did not mention Indian pricing, so check your regional store before buying.

faqs.q: When does the NBA 2K27 GTA 6 crossover start?
faqs.a: According to GameSpot, Vice City takes over NBA 2K27 starting November 27, with the themed content running across Season 3.

faqs.q: How much is the NBA 2K27 Vice City Edition?
faqs.a: GameSpot reports the digital-only Vice City Edition costs $80 and bundles the Season 3 Pro Pass. It features Miami Heat player Bam Adebayo on the cover.

faqs.q: Can GTA+ members play NBA 2K27 for free?
faqs.a: Yes, GTA+ members on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S can play the standard edition from November 27 to January 15, 2027, per GameSpot. They get 20% off if they decide to buy it.
